description: Sanz Rodrigo, Javier and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented platform integrates cloud Jupyter notebooks that run wind-model benchmark postprocessing and evaluation. A GABLS3 demonstration establishes executed computational functionality. A later prototype description discusses prospective SeaDataCloud and EUDAT integration; these plans are kept separate from the notebook workflow already demonstrated. The platform supports comparison of model performance against benchmark evidence. Current hosted-service availability, source-code licensing and complete implementation of later planned services remain unspecified. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
